worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.summary: Rotates its gears to raise its own Attack and sharply raise its Speed.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.use.0: Become a different machine at the start of a fight
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.use.1: Gain speed before running someone down
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.use.2: Shift before a closing enemy arrives
Shift into another gear: Attack +%1$s stages and Speed +%2$s stages, both kept until the encounter fades.
The gear ring has a %1$s-block radius and keeps turning for about %2$s s after the shift; judgement and presentation share that radius, so the picture is the area.
Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s. Gear options: torque favours Attack, overdrive favours Speed; both total +3 stages.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.timing: Telegraph scales with Speed and recovery with body size; shifting stops the user and can be interrupted.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.preference.g: Both gears total +3 stages and only split them between Attack and Speed: choose torque to hit harder, overdrive to chase and reposition.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.preference.a: Consider shifting when a threat is within this distance; larger prepares earlier and risks interruption.
Stop shifting when a threat is closer than this; fall back to the normal order instead of standing still to buff.
